purpose: Prepare a complete, clean and independently auditable corrected primary comparison; NO campaign runs launched by creating this file
changes_since_legacy_study: Concurrent aggregate CPU capacity is enforced in addition to GPU and memory
Carbon objective is modeled execution-time-integrated forecast intensity rather than optimizer-endpoint intensity
Fixed arithmetic forecast-week region means determine offline planning/eligibility, rather than changing forecast signal by optimizer iteration
Forecast week is repeated cyclically beyond the observed 168 hours as an explicit counterfactual model assumption
Additional per-run final assignment, schedule and modeled carbon mass are persisted
provenance: Each JSON shard must record exact full Git SHA, clean tracked checkout, versions and protocol-file SHA256. The audit must reject mixed SHA or changed protocol.
limitations: Not actual data-centre electricity or measured carbon emissions
UK regional forecasts are assigned to logical cloud-edge resource slots counterfactually
Repeating the observed forecast week is synthetic extrapolation; it is not observed later-week intensity
Fixed full-week intensity is assumed available to the offline planner; this is not an online causal forecast benchmark
Host power and inactive idle GPU power are not modeled
A fixed region-mean planning carbon class threshold is not a per-timestep constraint guarantee
Changes to simulator and objectives make old tables/figures noncomparable
gates_before_publication: Obtain coauthor approval of the revised offline carbon policy and limitations
Verify pinned dependencies and source snapshot are reproducible
Run complete 120-shard cohort with no missing/invalid shards
Independently replay 13 final schedules per shard to verify CPU/GPU/memory feasibility and energy/carbon parity
Compute paired statistical results only from the complete corrected cohort
Regenerate every affected table/figure and revise claim language
Audit sensitivities/ablation separately rather than inventing results
